plainText:
Bea (Japanese: サイトウ Saitou) is one of Stow-on-Side's Gym Leader, known officially as Stow-on-Side Stadium. She specializes in . 

In Pokémon Journeys: The Series, Bea is a rival to Ash, participating in the World Coronation Series, with the goal of defeating and becoming the strongest Trainer in the world.
==In animation==
===History===
 
====Pre-series====
From a very young age Bea learned the technique of Karate from Galar with her father, since that age, she was very hardworking and with a great talent for it. At that time she met Chuck who trained with his father in the same martial art.

When she was older, Bea went on a journey through various regions in search of challenging other Fighting-type trainers like . This earned her a high reputation and a high ranking in the current World Coronation Series season.

====Pokémon Journeys: The Series====
 
Bea made her debut in Solitary and Menacing!. She first battled the Karate Master at the Fighting Dojo in Saffron City and won. Soon after, she was challenged to a World Coronation Series battle by and had a two-on-two battle with him. She used her and to battle and and emerged victorious without losing a single Pokémon, causing her rank to go up. 

During a flashback to Bea battle against Ash in Making Battles in the Sand!, is revealed that this battle destabilized Ash’s emotional. This forces Ash to look for new alternatives so that he can battle Bea again.

Bea eventually manages to grow in the rankings until she reaches position 193, leaving her way to Ultra Class closer and closer.

In Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!, it's shown that Bea was training at the Cianwood City with Chuck when she received a challenge from Ash who wanted a rematch, despite remembering the previous battle, Bea did not remember Ash's name. Bea accepted his challenge, using her and Grapploct to battle and Riolu. Although both sides do their best, the battle ends in a draw. Later, Chuck offers a table of sweets to Ash, Bea and Goh, during which time Ash and Bea declare their goal of winning the championship.

A silhouette of Bea along with her Grapploct was revealed at the end of Thrash of the Titans!, revealing that she had advanced to the Ultra Class of the World Coronation Series.

She made a brief appearance at the end of Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start! while watching Ash’s World Coronation Series match against Volkner.
 
In An Adventure of Mega Proportions!, it is revealed that Bea managed to reach the 30th position in the World Coronation Series, and that her next opponent in the competition will be Ash.

In Battle Three With Bea!, during the preparations for their battle in the next day, Bea is visited by Ash and Goh in her Gym, Bea takes the initiative and shows all her Pokemon in hand and Ash reveals that has evolved and his other Pokémon. Soon after, they are interrupted by who is carrying a bag of Poké Puffs and reveals to be Bea's friend. After a brief get-together, Bea reveals that her goal with this battle is to test herself and find answers from her encounters with Ash.
 
The next day, her battle against Ash begins, with each one using three Pokémon this time. Bea starts the battle with who faces , and after Ash switches to , Bea uses and , the latter facing Lucario in an intense battle. The battle is briefly interrupted by 's arrival at the Gym, but Bea and Ash soon decide to retake it to define the winner of the match.

The battle between Bea and Ash continues in next episode, during the battle Bea manages to defeat Ash's Sirfetch'd using Hawlucha and Pikachu using Grapploct. Ash then uses Lucario who manages to defeat the Jujitsu Pokémon after a tough battle.

The last remaining Pokémon on each side are and , that Bea immediately uses Gigantamax to defeat her opponent. In battle, even giving its all, Machamp ends up reverting to its original form and Machamp is defeated after Lucario uses its newly learned move.

After being finally defeated, Bea thanks Ash and congratulates him on his victory, saying that she hopes to battle him again, finally referring to him by his actual name. 

Bea re-encounters Ash during his visit to the Stow-on-Side Stadium in order to get Allister to help achieve Gigantamax form in The Winding Path to Greatness!. After a short conversation with him, Bea wishes him luck and Ash heads to the arena to train Gengar, in the next day, Bea joins Allister to follow up on the training results. Impressed by the sight, Bea remarked to Allister that it was rare for him to be helping others.
 ]]
Following Ash's promotion to Master Class and the revelation of the remaining members of the most powerful members of the World Coronation Series in Aim For The Eight!, it's indicated that Bea failed to be promoted to the next stage of the competition sometime after her battle with Ash.

Prior to Toying With Your Motions!, Bea traveled to Kalos again and was seen watching Ash's match against Leon in the finals of Masters Eight Tournament alongside Korrina and Gurkinn. They were seen again, quite apprehensive when Ash managed to awaken 's full power and the battle announcer compared the battle to the abilities of a .

In These Could be the Starts of Something Big!, Bea was shown having a battle against Hop, using Machamp to battle his as Leon watched. The winner of the battle has not been revealed.

===Character===
 ]]
Bea has a strong and confident personality. While she shows proper discipline and etiquette in battle, Bea speaks frankly and directly, calling "weak" and pointing out Ash's openings as she sees them.

Extremely powerful, Bea was able to defeat other experts like and the Kanto Fighting Dojo Karate Master. Like Ash, Bea aims to win against in the World Coronation Series, in order to prove herself as the strongest Trainer in the world. This secured Bea high rankings in the World Coronation Series and placed in the top thirty Trainers in the world before her battle with Ash in Battle Three With Bea!.

Despite being tough in battle, Bea has a more gentle side, like when she offered food to and and demonstrated also in the way Bea treats Allister. Although, Allister shows a certain fear in interacting with Bea.

Like her game counterpart, Bea also has a soft spot for sweets. For this reason, as revealed later, Bea became good friends with , who introduced Bea to the sweets found in the Kalos region.

Bea has a habit of forgetting 's name, before knowing him only as " 's Trainer" and later as " 's Trainer". Despite this, Bea recognized Ash's strength and has come to respect him since their second battle. And after the conclusion of the third battle between them in A Battle of Mega Versus Max!, Bea started calling Ash by his real name.

===Appearance===
In the anime, Bea's main outfit is the same as that worn by the character in the games. In The Winding Path to Greatness!, Bea is seen wearing the casual clothes shown in the concept art.
 

===Pokémon===
 
As revealed by the Karate Master in Solitary and Menacing!, Bea has a large team composed of several Pokémon of the Fighting-type. This is seen, during Bea's battles with Ash, where she uses different formations in the battles they have had.
 

Bea engages in her battles in a physical and brutal way. Bea also battles alongside her in complete sync, so that they both repeat the moves that are used in the battle and her idea of an ideal Pokémon Trainer is one who stands on equal footing with their Pokémon. 

Despite the tough appearance and stance, Bea's Pokémon appear to have a gentle spirit, eating the sweets that Chuck put on the table for the trainers and soon after, encouraging to do the same. This is seen again in Battle Three With Bea!, when Bea's Pokémon interacted and played with some of Ash's Pokémon. 
However, the rivalry between and was quite evident during the meeting between the two.

In Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start!, Bea was revealed to possess a Dynamax Band, that Bea uses to Gigantamax in her . That according to Korrina, makes Machamp the "true ace" of Bea's team.

=====Other=====
In Solitary and Menacing!, According to the Karate Master, Bea owns many . While some of them appeared in her later appearances, the rest were only present during a flashback in her debut appearance.

 

===Achievements===
 
 
=====World Coronation Series=====
Bea has competed in the World Coronation Series. Her rank and class are as follows:
Rank 751 (Great Class; prior to Solitary and Menacing!) 
Rank 193 (Great Class; prior to Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!) 
Rank: Unknown (Ultra Class; as of Thrash of the Titans!) 
Rank: 30 (Ultra Class; as of An Adventure of Mega Proportions!)

===Voice actors===
 

==In the manga==
 
=== ===
Bea debuted in Solitary and Menacing!, where she battled Ash in a World Coronation Series match. Just like in the anime, Bea wins the match without losing any of her Pokémon in battle.

Bea made one last appearance on Ultra Exciting from the Shocking Start! & Trial on a Golden Scale! (Part 2), in a fantasy together with other Trainers.

==Trivia==
Bea's ranking in Octo-Gridlock at the Gym! is the same number as her uniform in the Pokémon League of Galar.
Bea is the first:
Bea is Ash's first Rival to exercise the role of Gym Leader.
Bea is Ash's first Rival to be a type specialist.
Not counting main characters and Character of the day, Bea is the first female trainer since to have a full team revealed in the anime.
